definition: Sublation: the dialectical process of simultaneous negation, preservation, and elevation

contrasts.differential: Aufhebung preserves what it negates, simple negation destroys
Aufhebung transforms what it preserves, simple preservation leaves unchanged

definition: Spirit: the self-knowing actuality that develops through history and consciousness

contrasts.differential: Geist is self-conscious and self-determining, Natur is external and given

definition: Concept: the self-developing logical form that unifies universal, particular, and individual

contrasts.differential: Begriff is speculative thought, Vorstellung is representational thinking

definition: Mediation: the process by which something relates to itself through its other

contrasts.differential: Vermittlung is relation through other, Unmittelbarkeit is direct givenness

definition: Immediacy: the quality of being given directly without mediation

contrasts.differential: Unmittelbarkeit presents as self-sufficient, Vermittlung shows dependence on other

definition: Contradiction: the internal tension that drives dialectical development forward

contrasts.differential: Widerspruch is the motor of becoming, Identität is static self-sameness

definition: Becoming: the unity of Being and Nothing, the first concrete category

contrasts.differential: Werden is the movement between Being and Nothing, Sein is pure indeterminate immediacy
Werden contains both Sein and Nichts as its moments

definition: Being: pure indeterminate immediacy, the most abstract and empty category

contrasts.differential: Sein and Nichts are dialectically identical in their pure indeterminacy
Sein is immediate appearance, Wesen is the ground behind appearance

definition: Nothing: pure empty indeterminacy, dialectically identical with Being

contrasts.differential: Nichts and Sein are the same in pure thought yet produce Werden through their difference

definition: Essence: the truth of Being, the domain of reflection and ground

contrasts.differential: Wesen is the reflective ground, Sein is unreflected immediacy
Wesen remains in opposition, Begriff achieves unity of opposites

definition: Substance: the self-subsistent totality that must be grasped equally as Subject

contrasts.differential: Substanz is the given totality, Subjekt is the self-developing activity

definition: Subject: the self-relating negativity that develops through its own activity

contrasts.differential: Subjekt is active self-development, Substanz is passive self-subsistence

definition: Determinateness: specific quality that makes something what it is through negation

contrasts.differential: Bestimmtheit is definite through negation, Unbestimmtheit lacks determination

definition: Negation: the determinative process by which something is defined through what it is not

contrasts.differential: Negation defines through exclusion, Affirmation through inclusion

definition: Determinate negation: negation that preserves content and produces a new determination

contrasts.differential: bestimmte Negation is productive, abstrakte Negation yields empty nothing

definition: Dialectic: the self-movement of thought through contradiction to higher unity

contrasts.differential: Dialektik dissolves fixed determinations, Verstand holds them apart

definition: Appearance: the showing of Essence, the unity of inner and outer

contrasts.differential: Erscheinung is the manifestation, Wesen is what appears
Erscheinung has essential content, Schein is mere semblance

definition: Universality: the self-relating moment of the Concept that contains its particulars

contrasts.differential: Allgemeinheit is the universal moment, Besonderheit is the particularizing moment
Allgemeinheit abstracts from individuals, Einzelheit is concrete singularity

definition: Particularity: the moment of the Concept that mediates between universal and individual

contrasts.differential: Besonderheit differentiates the universal, Allgemeinheit subsumes particulars

definition: Individuality: the concrete unity of universal and particular in a singular being

contrasts.differential: Einzelheit is concrete singularity, Allgemeinheit is abstract universality

definition: In-itself: the implicit or potential mode of being, not yet developed or self-conscious

contrasts.differential: an sich is implicit potential, für sich is explicit self-relation
an sich is one-sided, an und für sich is the developed totality

definition: For-itself: the mode of explicit self-relation and self-consciousness

contrasts.differential: für sich is self-conscious actuality, an sich is unconscious potential

definition: In-and-for-itself: the fully developed unity of implicit and explicit, potential and actual

contrasts.differential: an und für sich is the completed development, an sich is the undeveloped beginning

definition: Externalization: Spirit's self-emptying into otherness as a necessary moment of development

contrasts.differential: Entäusserung moves outward into otherness, Erinnerung gathers back inward

definition: Recognition: the mutual constitution of self-consciousness through the other
